messages:
anya: Hey team — I need a short console elevation (30m) to rotate a KMS key used by the kv-store and run a targeted log scrub for PII that slipped into one trace. Will only run these two ops:
- `aws kms rewrap --key-id alias/kv-rewrap --target-key-id alias/kv-rot-2026` (single resource)
- `scripts/scrub-logs.sh --trace-ids 12345..12349 --dry-run=false`

Can someone approve scope and duration? Need this within the hour to meet support SLA. tagging @security-oncall 

security-oncall: Thanks @anya — please add the minimal justification in the JIT form (link below) and confirm exact resource ARNs. We need: reason, affected resource ARNs, exact commands, start ETA, duration, and the audit tag you will use. Session recording and AWS CloudTrail must be on. Also add the break-glass label only if this is blocking customer data exposure.

security-oncall: JIT form: https://jit.internal.redwood/cases/new — put `prod-kv-rotate-#1234` in the summary and add `audit:log-scrub-2026-03` as the audit tag.

anya: Putting ARNs here:
- arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345
- arn:aws:ec2:us-west-2:111122223333:instance/i-0abc123def456

I'll use audit tag `audit:log-scrub-2026-03` and ETA ~20m from now. Reason: traced PII in request traces 12345..12349 after ingest parser bug. Not a bulk redact.

kevin: I can approve once the JIT ticket is created and the justification field has the ARNs + link to the scrub script. I want the elevation scoped to `console.sudo` on the `redwood-prod` account and explicitly NOT to include `iam:CreateAccessKey` or other privilege escalations.

ops-bot: JIT ticket created by anya — https://jit.internal.redwood/cases/RA-2026-317 (status: pending). Assigned approver: kevin. Session recording and CloudTrail flags set by policy.

security-oncall: @kevin please review RA-2026-317. If you approve, we will grant `console.sudo` for 30 minutes starting when anya ACKs `start` in this thread. Also, please confirm monitoring will watch for unexpected list/attach IAM calls.

anya: RA-2026-317 updated with commands and ARNs. I will only hit the two commands above. If approved, I will `start` in-thread and paste the run logs and scrub script output to the ticket. Will not create keys or change IAM.

kevin: Reviewed and approves for 30m scoped to `console.sudo` on resources listed. No IAM changes allowed. Approver note: keep `audit:log-scrub-2026-03` tag. :+1:

security-oncall: Approved by kevin. Granting in 2m and notifying monitoring. Reminder: tag session with `audit:log-scrub-2026-03` and upload logs to RA-2026-317 when done.

anya: start

ops-bot: Elevation granted to anya (30m) — session id SESS-9067. Link to live session: https://console.redwood/sessions/SESS-9067 (recording will be attached to RA-2026-317)

oliver: watching — will help validate scrub output after run.

anya: ran `aws kms rewrap ...` and `scripts/scrub-logs.sh` — scrub output: `3 traces redacted, 2 traces flagged for manual review`. Pushed artifacts to RA-2026-317. Ending session now.

ops-bot: Elevation session SESS-9067 closed by anya. Recording uploaded to RA-2026-317. CloudTrail shows only kms:ReEncrypt and s3:PutObject (for artifacts). No IAM or policy changes detected.

kevin: Thanks — confirming I saw the artifacts and the audit tag. All good from my side. Closing ticket when security sign-off done.

security-oncall: Verified artifacts, audit tag present, and no policy escalation. Marking RA-2026-317 as resolved. Good run, team.
